**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **Law:** § 16.9 (p0300) selects the substantive laws of the State of New York — the preferred jurisdiction. The Confidential Disclosure Agreement (§ 8, p1499) and the EPL general terms (§ 16, p1587) are consistent, so there is no conflicting choice of law anywhere in the document set.
- **Forum:** p0301 requires any action for breach to be commenced "in a court sited within the State of New York" — a mandatory New York court venue. Targeted searches returned no arbitration provision at all, so the walk-away scenario (foreign seat / foreign exclusive venue) is not present.
- **Noted, not flagged:** venue is stated at state level rather than New York County specifically, and there is no express temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out. These fall short only of preferred wording and are recorded in the rationale.
- **Not flagged as adverse:** the jury-trial waiver and the [*]-year contractual limitations period are mutual and bind MSL equally; they are not GOVLAW deviations.
